notes: Stage 1 XPert library, reference-only for Stage 2 (the preprint X-Pert model is excluded from Stage 2 deployment; this item is the Stage 1 implementation the workflows import). No public download record exists: the library is author-provided and its version is unknown. Split in ticket 04: `source/` keeps the upstream-shaped library (`src/`, `pretrain/`, `LICENSE`), `local/` keeps the locally-authored material (routing index, run logs, reference metadata, generated metrics, figure-reproduction notebooks, editor/agent settings) declared one path at a time in local_additions[]. Absorbed from the deleted VALIDATION.md "X-Pert (Chen-Li-17, distinct from Stage 1 xpert/)" section: it ran in a dedicated Python 3.13 venv with scperturb==0.1.0, einops_exts and local torchtext.vocab/scib shims; drug mode with dosage_mode_type=4 (DoseFiLM) at 2,000 genes forwards to (1,1,2000) and the DoseFiLM gradient norm 0.0259 proves the continuous log10(1+dose) path is connected; the package is alpha-quality (xpert/__init__.py exports only the data loader, analysis/analyzer.py references an unexported PerturbationModel).
